meaning.en: Someone who or that which dumbfounds.
meaning.vi: Ai đó hay cái đó mà chết lặng.

sentences.en: He was utterly dumbfounded at the bad news.
sentences.vi: Anh hoàn toàn chết lặng trước tin dữ.

sentences.en: She said she was dumbfounded by the allegations.
sentences.vi: Cô ấy nói rằng cô ấy đã chết lặng trước những cáo buộc.

sentences.en: He was dumbfounded by the allegations.
sentences.vi: Anh chết lặng trước những lời cáo buộc.

sentences.en: She was dumbfounded by the terrible news.
sentences.vi: Cô chết lặng trước tin khủng khiếp.

sentences.en: She was completely dumbfounded by the news.
sentences.vi: Cô hoàn toàn chết lặng trước tin này.

sentences.en: We were completely dumbfounded by her rudeness.
sentences.vi: Chúng tôi hoàn toàn chết lặng trước sự thô lỗ của cô ấy.

sentences.en: He was completely dumbfounded by the incident.
sentences.vi: Anh hoàn toàn chết lặng trước sự việc.

sentences.en: They were dumbfounded by all the damage done by the storm.
sentences.vi: Họ chết lặng trước mọi thiệt hại do bão gây ra.

sentences.en: He was dumbfounded when Ryskamp didn't apologize.
sentences.vi: Anh chết lặng khi Ryskamp không xin lỗi.
